newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Inter-Roller jumps on bonus, rights issue.
newsitem.headline: Inter-Roller jumps on bonus, rights issue.

text.p: Shares in material handling company Inter-Roller Engineering Ltd jumped more than 10 percent on Thursday morning on news the company was proposing a one-for-two bonus issue of shares and a one-for-two renounceable rights issue.
Inter-Roller shares climbed 8.5 Singapore cents to a high of 87.5 before slipping back to 84 by 0430 GMT.
Announcing the issues on Wednesday evening, the company said both would involve the creation of a minimum of 17.04 million and a maximum of 20.73 million new shares in the company.
The rights issue was expected to raise net proceeds of between Singapore $5.7 million and S$7.0 million, it said.
